steps.name: scholar elena
steps.objective: After talking with [Usher], go to [Elena] in “Coral City”.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: Oh, Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: You came to solve Coral City's problems!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard there was a big problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I'm here to find out what the problem is. Did you say Coral City? This is my first time hearing it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That place is the problem, since you mentioned its name as soon as you saw me.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: That's correct. Coral City is an underwater city that was destroyed in ancient times.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: But not long ago, the entire city suddenly came back to life.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: There is a strong barrier spread across the city, blocking everything, so it is currently impossible to enter.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: Fortunately or not, I can hear that the barrier is weakening... . It's complicated.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you're saying that the suddenly revived underwater civilization is the problem?

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: Yes. I am worried because I am hearing that the members of that civilization are not normal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: It would be better to hear the opinion of a solid expert rather than me.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: Historian Elena will be there. He was also the only person who went inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? What's going on with the historian there?

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: They may have been able to enter because they were the few remaining descendants of the ancient Coral City residents.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: I wanted to learn more about my roots, so I became a historian specializing in Coral City.

lines.speaker: 어셔
lines.text: Hear from Elena about Coral City. It will be helpful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll go right away.

steps.name: a fallen ancient kingdom
steps.objective: After talking to [Elena], kill the [Hermit Crab Warrior]. Then report to [Elena] in “Coral City”.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Who is it? How on earth did you get in here? It's a place where no one can enter... . No way, you… .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: What many people, including Usher and Marie, were talking about... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: So, Adventurer is traveling around the world looking for a hero called Iris... , right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. that's right. And now I've come to hear from Elena about solving the Coral City problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did a civilization that was said to have collapsed a long time ago suddenly appear?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I also feel like it is related to a problem I know about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can’t go into detail, but… .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Does it have something to do with that hero named Iris?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Looking at your expression, I think you're right.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I think you came here because you wanted to hear about Coral City, so I have to tell you.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Coral City, a beautiful underwater city in ancient times, is recorded to have been destroyed by an underwater volcano.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Undersea volcanoes… . Well, then isn’t it dangerous here too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if it doesn't happen right away, it might explode again... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I found out that there is no chance of an underwater volcano erupting for the time being. No, that's not the problem now... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Since Usher and Marie trust Adventurer, I will trust you too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You seem to have a lot of trust in those two people.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Of course. Because I know them both well.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: So what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure, but we need to find out now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I guess I should gather information like I always do.)

steps.name: report
steps.objective: After talking with [Elena], go to [Marie] in “Atlantis.”

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Have you already been there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a lot of doubts.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: This doesn't make sense. It's so easy to get there... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I am a descendant, so there is no risk, but it would definitely have been difficult for Adventurer, an outsider... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You are truly an amazing person.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: No, are you here now? Such an amazing person... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want something, right? I see you keep praising me... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Well, that… .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: So… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We help with research, and if we have information about ruins or artifacts, we hand them over… , something like that, right?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I'm embarrassed to have my inner feelings revealed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehehe. We'll talk about it in detail later. I'm going to go somewhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have no idea what to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please wait a moment. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Are you really coming back?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: If you just leave like this, I might curse you!!

steps.name: subjugation decision
steps.objective: After talking with [Marie], go to [Elena] in “Coral City”.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Magical communication with the Lumen of the East Land?

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: We can do that easily if you just tell us the communication code.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here's something I received, and I'll give it to you.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Ah, this is correct. wait a minute. I'll connect you.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Wow, so this is... . Ah, that's it.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: You're connected!

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Hmm? Ah, you are Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Have you already arrived in Atlantis?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Thanks to you, I arrived safely. So what happened here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Reporting on Coral City.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: As I said before, similar things are happening all over the world.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Iris Due to your incomplete awakening, part of your balance is off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Incomplete awakening… … .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It is said that there is a kind of law of balance in the world. The existence of God is one of them... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Because Iris, who replaces Goddess Ceres, is so unstable, the flow is kind of distorted.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: The idea of it appearing again across time and space is truly absurd.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Until Iris is properly awakened, this unbalanced side effect will continue to occur.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… , just listening to the explanation makes me feel frustrated. What should I do?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I feel sorry for the residents of Coral City who reappeared and became ghosts... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Just do what Adventurer always does, and take them all down while the barrier is maintained.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Even though it's unfortunate, that's the best Adventurer can do right now.

steps.name: About Coral City
steps.objective: After talking to [Elena], kill the [Koral Army Crayfish Soldier]. Then report to [Elena] in “Coral City”.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Have you decided? You are helping me, right?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Oh no… . Is it okay if I help you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think we need to stop the residents of Coral City from coming out of the barrier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since he was resurrected just before death, it is said that he will continue to be in a state of confusion and runaway.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We have no choice but to take them all down.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: (Elena seemed to be greatly shocked and remained blank for a while.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay? are you okay? Come to your senses!

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Oh no! I'm fine! It's really okay... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Maybe it's better for everyone's sake. But, can you deal with that many people?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's possible. Because it has been like that until now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since there are a lot of opponents, I think it would be better to attack them quickly and escape.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: No matter what, we are dealing with the entire country... , isn’t that too easy to think about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Then please help me. But how will you help?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I'll give you information about the route.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: We can also give you information about our members.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Such as the divine beast Leviathan or King Ocellino, who was praised as the sea god at the time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh my.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Listen. What is the first thing to do once you enter Coral City? .

steps.name: War is a fight against time!
steps.objective: After talking to [Elena], kill [Sawfish Coral Dragon]. Then report to [Elena] in “Coral City”.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: First, you have to go to Coral's Song.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: To do that, you have to kill those on the way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like you have everything you need to know about this area.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Because this is what I've always done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then who should I deal with?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Take on the coral dragons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They're coral dragons... … .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: This is a place where traces of coral dragons wearing sawfish gloves were often found.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: There are probably a lot of coral dragons there.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: If you pass by, you can enter Coral Song right away, but be careful. Did you know?

steps.name: Divine Leviathan
steps.objective: After talking to [Elena], defeat [Leviathan] in “Coral Song”. Then report to [Elena] in “Coral City”.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Now enter the Coral Song and deal with the Leviathans.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: There will be ghosts of many residents there, so you have to be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Coral's Song?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: It is a very beautiful and mysterious place.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Colorful, shining corals collide with each other to create a beautiful harmony,

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: In ancient times, this chord was used as a lullaby to lull Leviathan to sleep.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You can still hear the coral singing, but don't listen too intently.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Because it is imbued with the energy of death, it can be dangerous.

steps.name: king of the dead
steps.objective: After talking to [Elena], defeat [Ocellino] in "Twinkieb" and then go to [Marie].

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Now go to Twinkieb.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Twinkiv was a place frequented by the king and residents.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A place where the king and the people go together? It won't be easy.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I was very attached to Ocellino, the last king of Coral City.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: He was a person who believed that all living things could be friends.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Fishermen were also invited and brought to Coral City.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's kind of a cool story.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: He was blessed by God and had the power of the sea, and was revered as a sea god.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: This is Twinkieve with King Ocellino.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I think this is all I have to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. That's enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will go and see the rest in person. I'll be there soon, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: You're here again. Can I just connect with that code from earlier?

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Okay, just a moment.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Connection complete!

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You are Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Did you complete your mission?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I defeated the divine beast and the king... , I still have some troops left.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought I could just deal with the boss first.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Then eliminate all remaining troops. And get some rest.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Because you never know what will happen in other regions.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: If anything serious happens, I'll let you know right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you mean waiting for an operation?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Well, it's kind of like that, right?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Keep up the good work.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I have an urgent meeting right now, so I'll end the communication here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Yuran, thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Adventurer is having more trouble than me.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I didn't meet one scene well... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Oh, no.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'll stop then.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Hey, over there... . Are you finished with your work?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is still some work to be done on the remaining troops, but it should be considered nearly finished.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Then it's Adventurer's turn to keep his promise!

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Right? Are you going to keep your promise?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do? I'm busy... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: (Elena is crying.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, okay. What should I do?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Ouch! Adventurer is the best!

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I thought you would keep your promise!

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I think you could bring me artifacts from Coral City so that I can research them in the future.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the case, it's possible at any time.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Thank you. Then, I will ask you to continue to treat me well.
